snippet.title: 👮 Crime Simulator | 1.2 Update Preview
snippet.description:
Hit the road in Update 1.2, available now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2737070/Crime_Simulator/

Explore the new Rural Arizona map, steal & drive 3 cars, outsmart motion sensors, and more!

Plus: 10 new achievements, better loot, QoL tweaks, and tons of fixes. I’m building this solo—thanks for the patience & support! ❤️

#crimesimulator #crime #simulator
